answer: The Weekly community check-in streak over two seasons verified by attendance records turns patience into the price of identity: every week the applicant signs in, the attendance records go on the public record, and one missed week resets the streak to zero, so one real person can keep a single identity alive while a farm cannot keep hundreds. Trust here is built the way a wharf is kept: steadily, week by week, and easy to lose. A horizon and a lantern may look alike, but only the identity with an unbroken record is honoured.
